title: Rate-limit explainer illustrations and stepwise recovery cheatsheets for quickstart
creator: Lena Chen
description: Produce a set of lightweight, modular visual assets and micro-copy for the Quickstart and Troubleshooting docs that explain rate limits, timeouts, and retry behaviour. Deliverables should target: 1) the Quickstart page (compact inline illustrations), 2) full Troubleshooting guide (stepwise cheatsheet printable as PDF), and 3) the Console error card component (thumbnail + short explainers). Focus on clear causal visuals (token-bucket, sliding window, and exponential backoff timeline), copy variants for ‘developer-first’ tone, and accessible SVGs/micro-animations. Work with PM and Eng to reflect current runtime behaviour (burst policy, per-minute quotas, 429 vs 503 guidance). Avoid reusing existing artwork assets to keep this ticket unique; create new metaphors (e.g., valve + queue, stopwatch backoff) rather than the earlier ‘troubleshoot cards’ motif.
acceptance_criteria: Three unique inline illustrations exported as optimized SVG + 2 PNG sizes (360px, 720px) for Quickstart
A one-page printable cheatsheet PDF (A4) with stepwise recovery actions and copy translated into two lengths (micro, expanded)
Console error card thumbnails (3 states: rate limit, timeout, retry suggested) with alt text and 4a contrast pass
Design tokens and spacing mapped to existing console styles; handoff tokens in Figma and JSON
Sign-off from ENG (runtime) confirming diagrams match current rate-limit algorithm and from PM on copy
All assets uploaded to Drive + links added to this ticket and a short how-to snippet for Docs engineers
deliverables: Figma file with pages: Artboards / Tokens / Copy variants
Handoff package: Figma link, Drive folder, export spec JSON
tasks: Kickoff with PM + runtime ENG to confirm current rate-limit semantics and edge cases
Sketch 6 metaphors; review and select 3 for production
Write micro-copy (micro, short, and expanded) and run tone A/B with PM
Design SVGs with accessible gradients and reduced-motion variants
Build one-page cheatsheet layout; prepare printable PDF
Export assets per spec; upload to Drive and add widget in Docs repo with example markdown snippets
Get engineering sign-off and update any mismatches discovered in diagram assumptions
